title: Automation Specialist - Especialista Senior
description:
Breve Descrição:

Responsável pela identificação conjunta de oportunidades relacionadas a automação e IA de atividades e processos operacionais do atendimento digital, por realizar a governança e curadoria das automações implementadas, bem como a responsabilidade de contribuir com o desenvolvimento de novas soluções de automação/IA personalizadas e/ou prontas para uso alinhadas à evolução do negócio junto ao time de infraestrutura de TI.


Principais atividades:

  • Elaborar o roadmap evolutivo do atendimento digital, considerando a estratégia de negócio e o contexto tecnológico, incluindo a evolução de soluções digitais e iniciativas com agentes de IA.;
  • Estabelecer padrões para soluções para o atendimento digital por meio de contribuições para a criação e manutenção da arquitetura de referência aplicacional, funcional e técnica, garantindo governança e aderência corporativa.
  • Apoiar equipes de negócio e equipes técnicas no direcionamento de soluções para o atendimento digital, contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais em novos projetos ou necessidades evolutivas do atendimento digital.
  • Manter a visão de futuro do atendimento digital, identificando e avaliando gaps da arquitetura atual e propondo melhorias.
  • Buscar e propor oportunidades de evolução do atendimento digital ou adoção de novas práticas tecnológicas, por meio de estudos e prospecção de mercado em Telecom e Digital.
  • Coordenar ou executar a evolução da arquitetura existente utilizando melhores práticas, ferramentas emergentes e alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas.
  • Prospectar e avaliar evoluções aplicacionais em trabalho conjunto com grupos multidisciplinares.
  • Relacionar-se com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos, garantindo alinhamento técnico entre arquitetura, digital e negócio.
  • Participar de PoCs para validar implementações, incluindo componentes aplicacionais e funcionalidades emergentes relacionadas à automação e IA no atendimento digital.


Experiência, conhecimentos e formação:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura de Software, Engenharia de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência sólida na elaboração e manutenção de arquiteturas de referência corporativas, com foco aplicacional e funcional.
  • Vivência em definição de padrões arquiteturais, governança técnica e alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Experiência em apoiar múltiplas equipes na definição de soluções, avaliando requisitos, gaps e riscos tecnológicos.
  • Histórico na evolução de arquiteturas corporativas, propondo melhorias com base em práticas de mercado e tendências tecnológicas.
  • Atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares, contribuindo para decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Participação em PoCs e validação de soluções em cenários complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, preferencialmente com exposição a iniciativas digitais e aplicações de média/alta complexidade

title: Virtual Assistant - Real Estate Operations & Marketing
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

• Monitor and update status changes across all platforms in real time


Marketing & Lead Management

• Design and distribute e-blasts, brochures, newsletters, and social media posts using the Compass Marketing Center

• Manage the team’s Instagram and Facebook pages, supporting content creation, scheduling, and posting

• Coordinate print campaigns and seasonal marketing drops, including mail execution via Postalytics

• Support lead management and follow-ups as needed


Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

• Support team events and client-facing initiatives as needed

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

• Real estate experience strongly preferred, particularly in U.S. real estate operations

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using: Google Workspace, E-signature tools, CRM systems, Canva, and AI (ChatGPT)

• Strong written communication skills, with excellent grammar and clarity

• Highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage follow-ups, deadlines, and shifting priorities independently

• Ability to organize tasks, track progress, and proactively flag issues

• Professional, confident, and polished demeanor when interacting with clients, agents, and vendors

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, time-sensitive real estate environment

• Ability to work independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication and status updates

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Requirements:

  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

title: React Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a React Developer to join our Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Important Notes for Submission

  • Kindly prioritize candidates with immediate availability and confirm their commitment to 8 - 4 hrs/day with PST overlap.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico.


Evaluation Process

  • Candidates complete Interest Check Form (ICF)
  • Shortlisted candidates only will be invited for MTI

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to join the Customer Identity (CI) team that is central to the enterprise, focused on ensuring customer data is accurate, consistent, and readily accessible. This critical data is the foundation for essential business processes, including personalized marketing, analytical reporting, and seamless online and in-store checkout and customer service experiences.


They manage a wide array of high-performance, scalable batch and real-time services. These services are utilized at numerous customer interactions, such as in-store purchases, online orders, rewards program enrollments, and activations from various marketing channels (Email, Direct Mail, SMS, Push notifications, etc.). By leveraging modern development practices, tools, and technology platforms, the CI team builds capabilities that empower customer-facing and checkout teams to deliver personalized, relevant, and frictionless experiences, ensuring customers realize value with every interaction.


Core hours:

This team operates in every major US time zone from Pacific to Eastern. Core hours would be considered 10 am CST - 4 pm CST with 2 hours spilling over either direction based on location.


Required Skills:

Non-Negotiable Requirements
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java, particularly Spring Boot.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.


Tech Stack:  Java, Springboot, Redis, Relational Database (MySQL, Oracle), NoSQL Database (Mongo), Kafka, Cloud engineering (Docker/Kubernetes), Node.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS, React, Angular, Testing framework (Junit, Jest).


Bonus Skills:

Experience with GCP suite (BigQuery), Airflow, and Web framework (Astro).


Duration:  3 months; end date being March 31, 2026, with the possibility of being extended based on team needs.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.

title: Performance Static Designer
description:
ReciMe is a recipe app revolutionizing how cooks organize, plan and shop their recipes. Our smart importing tool enables users to aggregate all their recipes in one platform within seconds - whether those recipes came from an Instagram video, recipe blog or grandma’s recipe box.


We’ve been a Top 10 app in the US App Store’s Food category for months and were recently featured on The Drew Barrymore Show.


Now, we’re looking for a Performance Static Designer to join our team!


You’ll be responsible for creating static and carousel ads for Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok and Pinterest.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to adapt content for different platforms, test variations, and bring ad concepts to life. Your designs will play a key role in driving engagement, conversions, and brand growth.

title: Coordenador(a) Sênior de Performance e Mensuração (Mídia + Dados)
description:
Sobre a Not Agency


A Not Agency é uma consultoria de inteligência digital, mídia e ciência de dados que atua junto a alguns dos maiores players do mercado nacional. Combinamos profundidade analítica, execução técnica de excelência e visão estratégica para transformar dados em resultados reais.

Valorizamos profissionais com base sólida em áreas exatas, curiosidade intelectual e atenção a detalhes — que desejam crescer em um ambiente remoto, colaborativo e de alta performance, propício ao desenvolvimento contínuo e à construção de carreira.


Missão da posição

Coordenar a estratégia e a operação de mídia de performance (Meta, Google e demais canais aplicáveis) para e-commerce e negócios digitais, assegurando consistência de mensuração, qualidade analítica e otimizações orientadas a indicadores de negócio (receita, margem, CAC, LTV, recorrência e eficiência incremental). A posição também é responsável por estabelecer rotinas de gestão, padrões de análise e documentação de aprendizados junto ao time e aos clientes.



Principais responsabilidades


Estratégia e gestão de investimento

  • Definir, em conjunto com a liderança e o cliente, a estratégia de performance por canal e etapa de funil (aquisição, ativação, retenção), com metas e premissas claras.
  • Conduzir o planejamento e a distribuição de verba (pacing), com projeções, cenários e recomendações de realocação quando necessário.
  • Garantir governança de conta: estrutura de campanhas, segmentações, públicos, keywords, negativas, criativos e ofertas, com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.


Análise, otimização e experimentação

  • Acompanhar diariamente os principais indicadores (impressões, cliques, CTR, CPC, CPA, receita, ROAS e demais métricas relevantes), identificando desvios, causas prováveis e ações prioritárias.
  • Conduzir rotinas de experimentação (testes A/B ou testes controlados quando aplicável), com hipóteses bem definidas, critérios de sucesso, análise e registro de aprendizados.
  • Produzir análises orientadas a decisões: identificação de padrões, outliers, queda de receita, mudanças de mix, saturação, impacto de criativos e variações por público/região/dispositivo.


Mensuração e qualidade de dados (em parceria com Analytics/Engenharia)

  • Garantir a integridade mínima de tracking para tomada de decisão: eventos, conversões, UTMs, parametrizações e consistência entre plataformas.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com o time de dados para diagnóstico e correção de gaps de mensuração (GA4, GTM, APIs/conversões, deduplicação e regras de atribuição operacionais).
  • Assegurar que relatórios e painéis reflitam a realidade do negócio (não apenas métricas de plataforma).


Relacionamento com cliente e comunicação executiva

  • Apresentar resultados e recomendações com clareza, consistência e objetividade, incluindo riscos, trade-offs e plano de ação.
  • Conduzir reuniões semanais/mensais com foco em decisão, priorização e evolução contínua.
  • Preparar materiais executivos quando necessário, com narrativa e evidências.


Coordenação e padronização

  • Coordenar a rotina operacional e analítica, orientando analistas e/ou parceiros (internos e externos) quando aplicável.
  • Criar e manter padrões de trabalho: checklist de saúde de contas, modelos de análises, templates de fechamento mensal, documentação de testes e playbooks.



Requisitos essenciais

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos em mídia de performance com atuação avançada em pelo menos dois grandes ecossistemas (ex.: Google e Meta).
  • Experiência com e-commerce e indicadores de negócio (receita, margem, CAC, LTV, recorrência), com capacidade de conectar decisão de mídia a impacto.
  • Domínio de rotinas de otimização e estrutura de conta (campanhas, públicos/segmentações, keywords/negativas, criativos e oferta).
  • Conhecimento sólido de GA4 e familiaridade prática com Google Tag Manager (leitura/validação e diagnóstico de tracking).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado (organização e análise de dados; tabelas dinâmicas; funções e manipulação).
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal consistente, organização e autonomia para trabalho remoto.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência com BigQuery/SQL para análises exploratórias e validações de dados (mesmo que em nível intermediário).
  • Experiência com Looker/Looker Studio ou ferramentas similares de BI.
  • Vivência com metodologias de experimentação, incrementalidade e avaliação de impacto além de ROAS da plataforma
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação e materiais técnicos.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Corretor imobiliário
description:
Descrição da Empresa De Sá Imob.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Corretor Imobiliário para se juntar à DE SÁ IMOB em Londrina, PR. O profissional será responsável por intermediar a compra, venda e locação de imóveis, atendendo clientes e oferecendo suporte especializado em todas as etapas das transações imobiliárias. As tarefas diárias incluem visitar e avaliar propriedades, realizar apresentações e mostrar imóveis a potenciais clientes, negociar contratos e acompanhar processos burocráticos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Corretagem e Imóveis: Necessário conhecimento em corretagem e no mercado imobiliário, além de ser capaz de identificar oportunidades de negócios.
  • Serviço ao Cliente: Habilidade em atendimento ao cliente, com foco em fornecer um serviço de alta qualidade e atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Vendas: Experiência em vendas é essencial, incluindo a capacidade de negociar e fechar contratos de maneira eficaz.
  • Além dessas habilidades, serão considerados diferenciais o conhecimento em legislação imobiliária e a capacidade de utilizar ferramentas tecnológicas de gestão imobiliária.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

We are looking for Azure Data Engineer, Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Azure Data Bricks; Azure Data Factory; Azure Data Services

Experience with columnar and table formats (Parquet, Delta, Hudi, Iceberg).

Proactivity in problem-solving.

Document design patterns, best practices, and operational procedures.

title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

ID:

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
